source_snapshot.procedure: Board easy to plug/unplug; device redetects without error after plug cycle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL with de-energized service, retention and host+DPU recovery.

old_problem: BF3 FRU/slot/cable topology, de-energized service and retention criteria, plus host PCIe, DPU management/service/representor and network recovery oracles were absent.
disposition_reason: The row requires physical service but not live removal. ED-09 supports qualified powered-down handling and ED-03 allows FRU/topology/expected values as runtime configuration. A full host+DPU recovery matrix prevents generic enumeration from becoming a false PASS.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2271 and 2272, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve BF3 board plug cycle, proper seating and error-free redetection.
Drain host/DPU traffic, shut down, remove AC and discharge before one qualified ESD remove/reinstall cycle; no live service.
Bind BF3 FRU/serial/firmware, PCIe slot/riser and all power/management/network/thermal cables; photograph contacts, slot, bracket and retention.
After boot compare PCIe generation/width, DPU services/management/representors, network links and errors across all planes to baseline.
No power action, board/cable handling, boot, query or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Powered-down BF3 board reseat and host/DPU/network recovery
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact BlueField-3 board can be safely removed and reinstalled in its mapped slot with correct retention/cabling and complete host, DPU management and data-plane recovery.
required_package: Contact/slot/bracket seating criteria, one cycle and rollback
Expected PCIe, DPU services/interfaces, network links and error limits
test_case.test_command: Capture host+DPU baseline, quiesce, shut down/remove AC/discharge; a qualified ESD operator disconnects mapped attachments and removes/reinstalls the exact BF3 once using vendor retention/torque, documents contacts/slot/bracket/cables, then restores power and captures all-plane readiness/link/error evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The correct board is fully seated and retained with undamaged contacts/slot and correct attachments; after boot its FRU/firmware and PCIe width/rate match, all required DPU services/management/representors and network links return, and no disallowed errors appear.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical retention/cabling evidence and complete host+DPU+network recovery. Runtime map/procedure must be bound. Damage, wrong slot/cable, degraded PCIe, missing service/interface/link, new errors or failed recovery is FAIL.
safety_gate: Qualified ESD operator; workload drain, shutdown, AC removal and verified discharge.
No hot removal; one cycle only.
Stop on damage, resistance, wrong topology or retention uncertainty.
Do not power on before attachment/retention/foreign-object inspection passes.
test_case.recovery: On damage or incomplete multi-plane recovery, leave the platform safe, preserve evidence and use the approved spare/rollback teardown; never reseat again or power-cycle blindly.
